description: This file defines a template class HashTableBase for high-performance, compact hash table implementations using open addressing with power-of-two bucket sizes. It includes detailed comments on usage, node traits, and internal mechanisms for lookup, insertion, deletion, and resizing.

classes.name: HashTableBase
classes.description: A template class providing a high-speed hash table implementation with customizable node types, supporting lookup, insertion, deletion, and resizing operations.

methods.name: NodeLookup
methods.description: Performs a hash-based lookup for a node matching a given key, returning a mutable pointer to the node or suitable insertion point.

methods.name: UpdateAfterInsert
methods.description: Updates internal counters after inserting a node, possibly triggering a resize if load factor exceeds threshold.

methods.name: UpdateAfterRemoval
methods.description: Updates internal counters after removing a node, currently not shrinking the table.

methods.name: GrowBuckets
methods.description: Doubles the size of the buckets array and rehashes existing valid nodes to maintain performance.

methods.name: NodeClear
methods.description: Clears the hash table, freeing memory and resetting counters.

methods.name: NodeBegin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the first valid node in the table.

methods.name: NodeEnd
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the position past the last node.

methods.name: ValidNodesRange
methods.description: Provides a range of valid nodes for range-based iteration.
